description: Curated static UI-to-HTTP-handler workflows. Not browser or runtime acceptance; never infer unreviewed control bindings. Failure and recovery evidence is static branch inspection, not runtime testing.

cases.interpretation: GET query, direction and depth drive graph lookup; no canonical-graph data is created by the form.

failure_paths.label: Graph unavailable
failure_paths.signal: The handler reports missing canonical graph instead of tracing.
failure_paths.recovery: Build/import workbench.db; do not infer that the feature or entity is absent.
handler_markers: Canonical Workbench graph is not available. Build/import workbench.db

failure_paths.label: No unique search result
failure_paths.signal: A name-based fallback traces only when there is exactly one search match.
failure_paths.recovery: Narrow the query or select a canonical node ID.

cases.interpretation: Bounded on-demand capture observations; a graph edge alone does not prove execution.

failure_paths.label: 404: graph unavailable
failure_paths.signal: Runtime detail returns 404 when graph storage is unavailable.
failure_paths.recovery: Restore the graph and retry; do not interpret the 404 as no runtime evidence.

cases.interpretation: Source-qualified article link; a title without source/page ID must not be treated as canonical provenance.

failure_paths.label: Source-qualified page ID missing
failure_paths.signal: An unknown source/page ID clears the title and emits an error.
failure_paths.recovery: Verify provider and page ID; do not substitute an identically titled page.
handler_markers: The source-qualified Wiki page was not found.

failure_paths.label: Opened article ID mismatch
failure_paths.signal: A cached page with the wrong page ID clears article/evidence content.
failure_paths.recovery: Recheck the source-qualified evidence link and cached identity.
handler_markers: The exact Wiki source page could not be opened.

cases.interpretation: Submission starts a scrape/import job and may change the local Wiki cache. A job receipt is not a completed import.

failure_paths.label: 400: rejected scrape job
failure_paths.signal: ValueError from job creation becomes an HTTP 400 error response.
failure_paths.recovery: Inspect the error and correct the source URL; no job has been confirmed.

failure_paths.label: Job accepted, result pending
failure_paths.signal: The route returns a job receipt without waiting for import completion.
failure_paths.recovery: Inspect job status and Wiki cache health before claiming a page imported.

cases.interpretation: Reads cached pages and creates a temporary compressed download; export does not import or validate target behavior.

failure_paths.label: 400: unsupported source
failure_paths.signal: The source argument is validated before snapshot export.
failure_paths.recovery: Select a supported provider or All sources and retry.

failure_paths.label: 400: export operation failed
failure_paths.signal: Export exceptions remove the temporary directory and return an error.
failure_paths.recovery: Review the returned error and local cache/filesystem access; no completed export is established.

cases.interpretation: Locally restricted bridge console; loading the page neither provisions credentials nor starts the receiver.

failure_paths.label: 403: nonlocal client
failure_paths.signal: The console rejects non-loopback client addresses.
failure_paths.recovery: Open the Toolkit on the authorized local browser rather than weakening the guard.

cases.interpretation: Same-origin, local-only settings mutation for observation-file configuration, not an action in the connected game.

failure_paths.label: 403: local-origin guard rejected
failure_paths.signal: The handler enforces same-origin requirements before writing settings.
failure_paths.recovery: Use an authorized local browser with the correct origin headers.

failure_paths.label: 400: missing feed settings
failure_paths.signal: Enabling observation without character or telemetry folder is rejected.
failure_paths.recovery: Enter both values or leave observation disabled.
handler_markers: if not char or not folder:
character and telemetry folder are required

failure_paths.label: 400: cannot create feed
failure_paths.signal: File-system errors during telemetry file creation block the save.
failure_paths.recovery: Check the local folder path and permissions; failed save does not connect a client.

cases.interpretation: Observations can be stale or absent; a reported entity is a sampled client view, not a guaranteed DSP spawn match.

failure_paths.label: 422: invalid client ID
failure_paths.signal: The route rejects an invalid client ID.
failure_paths.recovery: Choose a known bridge client ID and correct its format.

failure_paths.label: Snapshot missing
failure_paths.signal: The JSON response contains a null snapshot when none is available.
failure_paths.recovery: Check feed freshness, receiver state and selected client before interpreting absence.

cases.interpretation: Searches indexed capture events by entity, exact message ID and opcodes; empty results do not prove absent events.

failure_paths.label: Event search not yet filtered
failure_paths.signal: Event lookup requires at least one event filter.
failure_paths.recovery: Supply entity, message ID or opcode filters; blank output is not a negative test.
handler_markers: selected_module == "events" and (entity or message_id or ev_opcodes)

failure_paths.label: 422: nonnumeric event message ID
failure_paths.signal: Invalid message_id values are rejected before opening a SQLite connection.
failure_paths.recovery: Enter a decimal integer message ID from captured evidence, or clear the message ID filter.
handler_markers: status_code=422, detail="message_id must be an integer"

failure_paths.label: No indexed matching events
failure_paths.signal: The handler queries indexed capture_events, not all gameplay.
failure_paths.recovery: Broaden filters and confirm the capture was indexed.
handler_markers: SELECT e.*, c.capture_label FROM capture_events e

cases.interpretation: Packet category/opcode filters use a separate indexed corpus; do not combine packet identity with event message ID.

failure_paths.label: Packet search not yet filtered
failure_paths.signal: Packet lookup requires category or opcode filters.
failure_paths.recovery: Select an opcode or category before interpreting a blank result.

failure_paths.label: Category maps to zero opcodes
failure_paths.signal: No classified opcodes produces an explicitly false SQL condition.
failure_paths.recovery: Try an exact opcode or verified category; empty rows do not establish no packets.

cases.interpretation: Opening the exception queue is read-only; separate POST controls can resolve or dismiss quarantine findings.

failure_paths.label: Filtered review queue empty
failure_paths.signal: Review records are filtered by status and kind after loading.
failure_paths.recovery: Use All statuses and clear kind filters; do not assume exceptions resolved.
